heroHistoire.subtitle: Perfect for restoring.
heroHistoire.description: A word too big for those with nothing to say. But perfect for those with something to restore.
heroHistoire.mobileDescription: A word too big for those with nothing to say. But perfect for those with something to restore.

fondateursSection.label: The Origin
fondateursSection.title: BORN FROM A REFUSAL.
fondateursSection.subtitle: The refusal to watch what should last disappear.
fondateursSection.description:
Three men of the trade watched quality slip for years. They decided to do the opposite. To design frames that go with a life, not a season. To ask of the work what the market stopped asking.
Every frame carries that promise: an object meant to last, not to be replaced.
fondateursSection.mobileDescription: Three men of the trade watched quality slip for years. They decided to do the opposite. Every frame carries that promise: an object meant to last, not to be replaced.

symbolesSection.label: Our Symbols
symbolesSection.title: SEVEN SYMBOLS.
symbolesSection.subtitle: Engraved in metal.
symbolesSection.description: What you wear tells what you believe.
symbolesSection.symbol1Desc: The balance between yesterday, today and tomorrow. An anchor in what founds, what builds, what lasts.
symbolesSection.symbol2Desc: The flower of France. Nobility isn't in the blood, but in the hand: you know it by what a man can do, never by where he comes from.
symbolesSection.symbol3Desc: The breath that binds. What connects those who build to those who will carry on.
symbolesSection.symbol4Desc: Passage and transformation. What comes through the trials, what is reborn stronger than before.
symbolesSection.symbol5Desc: The silent awakening. The one who sees before being seen.
symbolesSection.symbol6Desc: The eye that never closes. Broken then made whole, it sees what others look at without seeing.
symbolesSection.symbol7Desc: "Avenue de la Renaissance", engraved in gold. The street you'll find on no map, the address each of us carries wherever we go.

signatureSection.label: The Signature
signatureSection.title: A SIGN FOR YOURSELF.
signatureSection.subtitle: Just you and what you know.
signatureSection.description: At the temple tip. A crystal. Smaller than a pinhead. Lean in. Symbols appear, engraved in the metal. On the bridge, a number. Engraved for you. It will exist only once. Like you.
signatureSection.mobileDescription: At the temple tip. A crystal. Smaller than a pinhead. Symbols engraved in the metal. On the bridge, a unique number. Like you.

savoirFaireSection.label: Making
savoirFaireSection.title: MADE WHERE PRECISION IS A DISCIPLINE.
savoirFaireSection.subtitle: France, Korea, Italy.
savoirFaireSection.description: Our frames come to life between France, Korea and Italy, in workshops where rigor is a culture. Each place brings its mastery: the fineness of titanium in Asia, the precision of the finishes in Europe. We choose our partners for their standards, not their speed.

valeursSection.label: Our Values
valeursSection.title: FOUR FIBERS. ONE CROWN.
valeursSection.subtitle: Non-negotiable.
valeursSection.valeur1Desc: In front of every word, every image: does it prove, or does it announce? If it announces, we cut it.
valeursSection.valeur2Desc: Titanium that never rusts. Gold that doesn't flake. What isn't made to last never leaves the workshop.
valeursSection.valeur3Desc: We only promise what we can keep. Never on sale: a price that drops is a word taken back.
valeursSection.valeur4Desc: We don't measure a man by what he owns, but by what he honors. In our images as at the counter.
valeursSection.valeur5Desc: What is well made can be repaired; what can be repaired is kept; what is kept is handed down.

collectionsSection.label: The Collections
collectionsSection.title: One house. Four collections. Nothing by chance.
collectionsSection.collection1Desc: Where it all begins. The striations. The signature.
collectionsSection.collection2Desc: The Trident. What we hand down.
collectionsSection.collection3Desc: The Fleur de Lys. What we build.
collectionsSection.collection4Desc: The Ankh, the Scarab, the Eye. What crosses 5,000 years.
collectionsSection.quote: We don't collect models. We collect symbols.

engagementSection.label: Our Commitment
engagementSection.title: WHAT IS WELL MADE CAN BE REPAIRED.
engagementSection.subtitle: We hold to it.
engagementSection.description: Our frames are made to be adjusted, cared for, repaired. Because a well-made object deserves a second chance, and often a third. Even past the warranty, write to us: we look, case by case, at what we can do.
engagementSection.engagement1Desc: Our grandparents kept their things. Our parents started throwing them away. We choose.
engagementSection.engagement2Desc: Every piece has an origin. French design. Korean making. We tell you everything because we have nothing to hide.
engagementSection.engagement3Desc: More than 250 opticians. Some since day one. We build relationships, not contracts.

ambassadeursSection.label: Ambassadors
ambassadeursSection.title: They wear Renaissance
ambassadeursSection.description: Known faces. Different paths. One thing in common: they wear what lasts.
ambassadeursSection.quote: They don't wear Renaissance to be seen. They wear it because it's like them. Because it says something about them.
